referenceFunction.generalComment: The dataset consists of figures of the Itaipu hydropower station complemented with European data. Considered are the area used, the amount of turbined water and the greenhouse gas emissions. The lifetime is assumed to be 150 years for the dams and 80 years for the other material. The data describe a mix and can therefore not be used for an individual storage hydropower station. This dataset is recalculated based on Itaipu Binacional, Frischknecht et al. (1996) and Bauer (2007), complemented with data from Vattenfall (2008) and Diem et al. (2008).; UUID: e0a1e90a-da44-3f54-9187-3bdf139975d7
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Operation of an average storage hydropower station in Brazil. It includes the area transformed and occupied, the volume of the reservoir, greenhouse gas emissions, the consumption of lubricant oil and the amount of turbined water.
